title: Contexts and Signals
text: Decimal operations signal noteworthy conditions: result rounded, division hit zero, value overflowed. happens next depends context, signal gets one three dispositions: Trapped — operation raises classed R error. Reported — signal recorded flag surfaced warning. default signal haven’t trapped. Silent — signal recorded flag . flags sticky: raised, stay raised clear , can run whole computation check afterwards happened along way: operations round fit two significant digits, raising inexact rounded; flags simply stay raised across whole block.
